title: Spectral and Subspace Dynamics of LoRA in Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.08414v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is commonly used in both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), often under similar optimizer settings. Yet, how the different dynamics of the two stages manifest in the low-rank increment that LoRA optimizes remains unclear. Tracking the singular spectrum and subspaces of LoRA updates on mathematical reasoning tasks, we find that RL concentrates the spectrum at every learning rate, while SFT expands it at moderate learning rates; moreover, RL rotates the singular subspaces much faster than SFT at small learning rates. Interpolating between SFT and RL one ingredient at a time, we pinpoint group-mean baseline subtraction as the source of both contrasts. A quadratic multi-index model updated via LoRA unveils the underlying mechanism: group-mean baseline subtraction tilts the balance between two competing forces, coherent fitting and gradient noise, toward spectral concentration and faster s

translated_title: 监督微调与强化学习中LoRA的谱与子空间动力学
translated_abstract: 低秩适应（LoRA）通常同时用于监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）两个阶段，且往往采用相似的优化器设置。然而，这两个阶段的不同动力学如何在LoRA所优化的低秩增量中体现，目前仍不清楚。通过在数学推理任务上追踪LoRA更新的奇异谱和子空间，我们发现：在所有学习率下，RL都会使谱趋于集中，而SFT在中等学习率下则会扩展谱；此外，在小学习率下，RL旋转奇异子空间的速度远快于SFT。通过在SFT和RL之间逐个成分进行插值，我们确定了组均值基线减除是造成这两种差异的根源。通过LoRA更新的二次多指标模型揭示了其背后的机制：组均值基线减除使两种相互竞争的力量——一致性拟合与梯度噪声——之间的平衡发生倾斜，从而趋向谱集中和更快的（子空间旋转）……
tldr: 该研究通过追踪LoRA更新的奇异谱与子空间，发现强化学习相比监督微调表现出谱集中和更快的子空间旋转，并揭示了组均值基线减除是造成这两种差异的根本机制。
